phone.vg.title: Vanguard Learn
phone.vg.subtitle: Learn how money works. Practice money only; no real accounts.
phone.vg.growth.title: Growth explorer
phone.vg.growth.intro: What if you saved the same amount every month?
phone.vg.growth.what: What this means: money left to grow earns a little on top, and that extra earns too. Time helps the most.
phone.vg.assumption: These are assumed numbers, not promises. Real growth can be lower, higher or even negative.
phone.vg.safe: Lost money to a scam? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
phone.vg.footer: Learning only. Fictional money. Not advice to buy anything.
tip.needs_first.title: Needs first
tip.needs_first.body: When money comes in, pay for needs like food, rent and the bus pass before wants.
tip.emergency_fund.title: A small cushion
tip.emergency_fund.body: Keep a little aside every month for surprises (an emergency fund). Then a bill is not a crisis.
tip.time_helps.title: Time helps
tip.time_helps.body: Small amounts saved early can grow more than big amounts saved late. Try it in the Growth explorer.
tip.risk_and_return.title: Risk and return go together
tip.risk_and_return.body: Anything that might grow fast can also fall fast. Anyone promising sure, quick returns is a warning sign.
tip.otp_never.title: Your OTP is yours
tip.otp_never.body: No bank, shop or friend needs your OTP or PIN. Hang up, delete the message, tell an adult.
phone.snake.title: Snake
phone.snake.relaxed: A short break helped you relax: sanity +{{n}}
phone.snake.how: Swipe or use the arrows. Eat the coins; don't hit the walls or yourself.
